metadata.execution: Parallel isolated Python subprocesses; no relative timing claims.
metadata.sampling: Fixed input per size; paired SHA-256-derived rotation seeds. SE conditional on that input.
metadata.metrics: Mean rotations/key, final mean node depth, maximum final height across completed trials, mean logical random bits/key. Root depth is zero.
metadata.limits: Per-process address-space cap includes inputs, insertion and final validation. Deadline is wall time under parallel load. Stop larger sizes for a strategy/workload after a resource failure.
metadata.validation: Every complete tree passes BST ordering, parent links, cycles and full key-set checks; stored treap also matches an independent Cartesian tree.

geometric-target-local-repair.name: Geometric target local repair
geometric-target-local-repair.tag: Perfect-tree reference, at most two rotations
geometric-target-local-repair.note: Sample target depth with capped leading fair bits and L=ceil(log2(n))+1, including the new leaf. Stay at or above the target; otherwise repair a straight or bent ancestor path with at most two rotations. No record exceptions or height guarantee.

interval-target-local-repair.name: Interval-target local repair
interval-target-local-repair.note: Choose a repair level using the original 64-bit interval bands. Ordinary insertions perform at most two local rotations; strict new minima promote the leaf to the root. Expected fewer than three rotations per insertion from empty under iid uniform rolls. Ancestor walks can be long; no logarithmic-depth guarantee.

random-level.name: Random level · perfect-tree target
random-level.note: Sample a vertex uniformly from the smallest perfect tree containing n nodes, including the new leaf. Promote the inserted leaf to that depth if deeper; otherwise leave it unchanged. No priority extrema or height guarantee.

treap.name: Stored-priority treap
treap.note: Existing Python reference: independent 32-bit priorities, key tie breaker, stored external priority map.

geometric-target-local-repair-alternate.name: Geometric local repair · alternate
geometric-target-local-repair-alternate.note: Unmodified alternate implementation RandomLevelV213; records move count in stats.priority.

metadata.global_stop_reason: After every implementation/input pair completed 2,097,152 keys, a 4,194,304-key probe hit the 768 MiB cap inside the common BST validator (seen.add(id(node))). The main required validation allocations at that size are estimated at 816 MiB, before interpreter overhead. Remaining higher-size probes were cancelled or not launched to avoid repeating this shared validation-memory bottleneck.
